author: Totally Not Mark
description:
With the shower of praise the Avatar Aang film has justifiably received, I wanted to highlight the human story that has been at risk of being lost in the noise and adulation. Through emailing many of the animators and artists who have worked on this film, these are some of the troubling stories shared.

Written by  @AnimeAjay  

MUSIC COVERS USED:

Avatar's Love (AtinPiano)
Finale (ThePandaTooth)
title: Avatar Animators Break Silence
